items.html: No help timeout / escalation — a parked help_pending blocks indefinitely, like the human_gate; a reminder, a timeout route, or an escalation target is watchdog territory → L9

No non-blocking help — the declared variant where the marker homes in a help-link record collection (the ChildWorkflowLink precedent) and the agent keeps working while the ask is open. The blocking wait-slot form ships here; the dimension value is declared, the machinery is not → later
No durable ask channels — the HelpRequest is local/manual delivery like every directive; Slack/email/token-bearing external asks are the transport generalization → L8
No help routing beyond the bound operator — the ask goes to binding[operator], full stop; routing by expertise, on-call, or org structure needs identity + channels → L8/L10
No policy gating on help emits — the L2 pipeline filters state-moving transitions; whether policies should also filter asks (rate limits, question schemas per role) is deliberately open → later

No deferred-rework stash — the composite "park a rework instruction, apply it on completion" is one more marker with a declared apply-on-completion rule; explicitly owned by the watchdog slice, not L5-core → L6/L9
